name: Citizen (Vargr)
description: Citizens work in all industries and are employed by a range of organisations from independent companies to large corporations. This career covers the foundation of Vargr civilisation.

corporate.name: Corporate
corporate.description: You are a white-collar worker or senior management working for a corporation, or alternatively a government bureaucrat.

aide.name: Aide
aide.description: You serve as an assistant to your pack leader.

worker.name: Worker
worker.description: You are a blue-collar labourer in the industrial sector.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: You make a terrible mistake in your job causing a halt in production or the loss of a client. Lose SOC −1 and suffer DM-2 to your next Advancement roll.
mishaps.3: Hard times caused by a poor economic climate puts you out of a job. You must change your career.
mishaps.4: The company you work for is suspected of illegal activities. You can aid in the investigations and gain DM+2 to the Qualification check for your next career or refuse and gain an Ally.
mishaps.5: A revolution, attack or other unusual event forces you to leave the planet. Roll SOC 7+ to find a new pack or receive DM-2 to your next Qualification roll.
mishaps.6: A power struggle in your pack ends badly for you. Lose SOC −1 and gain a Rival.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: A power struggle in your pack forces you to choose sides. Roll SOC 8+ to support the winning side and gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll. If you fail, suffer DM-2 to your next Survival roll.
events.4: You enrol for further education. Roll on the Advanced Education skills table whether you qualify for it or not.
events.5: Your corporation or organisation grows. Gain DM+1 to one Benefit roll.
events.6: You receive advanced training. Roll EDU 8+ to increase one skill you already have by one level.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Vargr Life Events table.
events.8: You learn a corporate secret or political scandal. If you choose to profit by this, gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll, DM+1 to one Benefit roll from this career, lose SOC −1, and gain one of Streetwise 1, Deception 1 or a criminal Contact.
events.9: Your pack leader praises you on your excellent work. Gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.10: Your leader is losing the respect of the pack. Roll SOC 10+ to become the new pack leader and gain an automatic promotion.
events.11: You support a pack member who becomes the new leader. Gain an Ally and DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: You are well respected by your pack and superiors. Gain SOC +1 or an automatic promotion.
